commits.title: Assistant tool results and validation feedback
commits.before_text: Tool summaries read an error attribute from results, and input validation returned a generic message.
commits.after_text: Tool summaries use their standard success/error fields without reading result.error; validation returns the input-specific feedback.

commits.title: Mark helper tool text as untrusted data
commits.before_text: The helper wrapped raw tool text in JSON without an explicit instruction boundary.
commits.after_text: The helper labels text as untrusted data and encloses it in a text block; normal release tool rounds use compact summaries.

commits.title: Send compact assistant tool summaries
commits.before_text: Provider-facing tool messages included rendered directory text.
commits.after_text: Tool round-trips send counts, pagination and standard result fields instead of the full directory text.

commits.title: Resolve workflow documentation conflict markers
commits.before_text: The GitHub Actions optimization plan contained committed merge-conflict markers.
commits.after_text: The plan reads as a resolved document without conflict delimiters; application screens are unchanged.

commits.title: Structure helper tool results as JSON
commits.before_text: The helper passed tool-result text directly as message content.
commits.after_text: The helper emits an explicit tool_result JSON object; subsequent release changes further limit provider-facing payloads.

commits.title: Use safe assistant provider error messages
commits.before_text: Provider exception text was returned directly to callers.
commits.after_text: Provider diagnostics are logged with a request ID while callers receive a temporary-unavailability message. Later changes in this release restore specific input-validation feedback.

commits.title: Christmas themes, mentions and request navigation
commits.before_text: Themes lacked Christmas effect preferences; request updates used plain fields without mention suggestions; activity creation and requestor links needed additional navigation.
commits.after_text: Adds seasonal login and account themes, effect previews, stakeholder mention suggestions and notifications, highlighted update links, administrator activity creation, and requestor management links.

commits.after_text: Adds an opt-in native launcher and chat shell with starter actions and guided workflows. Provider integration stays disabled until configured; these captures show the shell only.
